menu_force_clear_desc: Kills DroidGuard, stops GMS & Chrome, clears Play Store data
menu_import_keybox_desc: Downloads and installs remote keybox to the active keystore backend

advance_tee_section: Fix TEE: OnePlus, RedMagic, Realme, Oppo…
advance_clear_all_detection_traces_desc: Deletes detector app data, temp files, resets props, removes ODEX
control_toggle_recovery_desc: Hide TWRP, OrangeFox, FOX and AERA recovery folders at boot
control_toggle_boot_props_desc: Set verified-boot, vbmeta, SELinux and warranty props to a locked, stock state at boot
control_toggle_boot_hardening_desc: Apply security prop hardening (ro.secure, ro.debuggable, etc.) at boot
control_toggle_bootloader_spoofer_desc: Remove conflicting bootloader spoofer packages at boot
control_toggle_rom_spoof_desc: Disable ROM-level spoof engines (PixelProps, PIHooks, etc.)
control_toggle_rom_fingerprint_desc: Strip custom ROM identity (LineageOS, crDroid, PixelOS, etc.) from build props at boot
control_toggle_suspicious_props_desc: Scan for and clear known root/emulator/tamper-indicating system properties, at boot and hourly
control_toggle_auto_keybox_update_desc: Every 12 hours, check the active keybox and install a new one if it is missing, revoked by Google, expired or softbanned
control_toggle_auto_target_desc: At every boot, add apps installed since the last scan to the target list
control_toggle_auto_target_immediate_des: Automatically add newly installed apps to the target list shortly after installation.
control_toggle_adb_disabler_desc: Master switch for hiding USB debugging, developer options, and OEM unlock
control_toggle_adb_disabler_usb_debug_de: Reset ro.debuggable, adb.secure and related debug props at boot
control_toggle_adb_disabler_oem_unlock_d: Report OEM unlock as unsupported at boot
control_toggle_action_gms_desc: Force-stop and clear Play Store, GMS, and DroidGuard processes
control_toggle_action_gms_force_stop_des: Kill DroidGuard, GMS, and Play Store processes; clear Play Store cache
control_toggle_action_gms_clear_data_des: Full data wipe of Play Store — signs you out, more aggressive than cache clear. Off by default.
control_toggle_action_target_desc: Regenerate the app target list for the active keystore backend
control_toggle_action_security_patch_des: Write spoofed security patch date to the active keystore backend
control_security_patch_detail_desc: Choose where the date comes from when Set Security Patch is on.
control_toggle_security_patch_bulletin_d: Fetch the latest patch date from the Pixel bulletin. Used only when PIF and the device have no date. Off uses the computed date.
control_toggle_action_boot_hash_desc: Read and write verified boot hash for attestation
control_toggle_pif_traces_desc: Removes leftover spoofing traces (PIHook, PixelProps, and similar) from your device — helps avoid detection by security-checking apps
control_toggle_rom_identifier_cleanup_de: Delete any build property containing a custom ROM identifier (LineageOS, crDroid, PixelOS, and more).
control_toggle_rom_prefix_cleanup_desc: Strip custom ROM prefixes (aosp_, lineage_) from build fingerprint and display id.
control_toggle_build_marker_cleanup_desc: Strip userdebug/eng traces from build.flavor and build.fingerprint, and -dirty suffixes from build version props.
control_toggle_lineage_identity_cleanup_: Spoofs LineageOS-specific properties so apps cannot detect a LineageOS-based custom ROM
control_toggle_nuke_lineage_desc: Medium risk: aggressively DELETES any prop whose value contains "lineage" at boot, instead of overriding it. Off by default.
control_toggle_custom_rom_identity_clean: Deletes leftover NikGapps/BitGApps/LiteGApps installer log files at boot. Irreversible delete, no backup.
control_toggle_multiroot_hide_desc: Moves leftover Magisk/KernelSU/APatch folders of the root solutions you are NOT using out of /data/adb at boot. Restored when turned off or on uninstall. Does nothing if the active root cannot be identified.
control_toggle_hide_rom_identifier_desc: Medium risk: deletes any prop whose key or value matches a known custom-ROM name, plus ro.modversion.
control_toggle_auto_target_blacklist_des: Blacklisted apps are never auto-targeted and are removed.
control_toggle_auto_target_cleanup_desc: Remove an app from the target list after it is uninstalled. Manually added apps that were never installed are kept
control_toggle_target_system_desc: Also scan and auto-target pre-installed system apps, not just user-installed ones
control_rom_build_cleanup_desc: Clean custom ROM traces, debug build types, and module residue from properties.
control_gms_detail_desc: Choose what runs when Kill Play Store is on.
control_adb_detail_desc: Choose what gets hidden at boot.
control_toggle_action_pif_desc: Run Play Integrity Fix auto-update scripts
advance_set_pif_desc: Runs Play Integrity Fix auto-update scripts
advance_set_verified_boot_desc: Manually set or refresh the verified boot hash
advance_kill_all_desc: Force-stops and clears data for all known detector apps
advance_wdevinel1_desc: Downloads attestation key and runs KmInstallKeybox vendor binary

pif_import_desc: Load a pif.json or pif.prop file
control_toggle_kernel_buildtime_desc: Set ro.build.date and ro.build.date.utc to the kernel build time so ROM and kernel dates match
control_toggle_rom_builtin_spoof_desc: Zygiskless mode: let the ROM's own GMS / Play Store spoof hooks run instead of blocking them. Turns Block ROM Spoof Engines off while on.
control_toggle_rom_builtin_spoof_detail_: Turn the top switch ON to let the ROM's own GMS and Play Store spoof hooks run instead of Jerry blocking them (zygiskless mode). The two options below only apply while the top switch is ON.
control_toggle_rom_builtin_gms_desc: Enable PIHooks / KIHooks (key attestation and props) for GMS
control_toggle_rom_builtin_vending_desc: Enable pixelprops vending spoof for the Play Store
pif_preview_saved: Preview mode: no device connected, changes are not saved.
pif_backend_inactive_open: PIF backend not active yet. Reboot after flashing, then open this page again.
pif_backend_inactive: PIF backend not active yet. Reboot after flashing, then try again.
pif_import_unfinished: Import did not finish ({err}). Use View pif.prop to check the current config.
pif_file_browser_missing: File browser not available, reload the page
omk_inj_hint: Target apps are normally managed from App Targeting. Edit this raw file only if you know the OMK injector format.
omk_empty: No editable settings found in config.toml.
omk_inj_saved: Saved. OMK applies a valid injector.toml automatically; use Restart injector for a clean routing boundary.
omk_no_backup: No original {file} saved yet. A copy is taken automatically before the first save.
omk_unsaved: Unsaved changes. Tap back again to discard them.
omk_err_os_version: Use auto or a number from 0 to 99
omk_err_boot_patch: Use auto, latest, YYYY-MM-DD or a decimal u32 value
omk_err_hex: Use auto, random or exactly 64 hex characters
omk_err_range: Use two numbers: min, max (for example 9, 21)
omk_err_range_order: Minimum cannot be greater than maximum
omk_note_vb_hash: Reboot the device to return vb_hash from random to auto.
omk_note_vb_key: If vb_key does not return to auto after the restart, reboot the device.
omk_inj_err_close: Keep the closing "]" line of scoop
omk_note_crypto: Private seeds that protect every key OMK created. They are read-only here and never leave this screen. Do not share them.
omk_note_device: Identity strings reported to apps. Private, redact before sharing screenshots. Requires KeyMint restart.
omk_hint_complex: Complex value, edit it in the file directly.
omk_hint_version: Managed by OMK. Do not change.
omk_hint_force_skip_system_biometric_hat: Only enable for a confirmed System KeyMint compatibility issue.
omk_hint_retire_stale_keybox_bound_keys: Applies at the next keybox reload.
omk_hint_os_version: Use auto or an integer from 0 to 99. Requires restart.
omk_hint_security_patch: auto, latest, or an exact date (YYYY-MM-DD). Applies live.
omk_hint_os_patchlevel: auto follows the effective security patch.
omk_hint_vendor_patchlevel: auto uses vendor patch sources, then the OS patch level.
omk_hint_boot_patchlevel: Accepts auto, latest, a date, or a decimal u32 wire value.
omk_hint_vb_key: auto, random, or 64 hex characters. Keep auto unless a fixed attestation profile is required. Requires restart.
omk_hint_vb_hash: auto, random, or 64 hex characters. Requires restart; random to auto needs a device reboot.
omk_hint_device_locked: Reports the state only; it does not lock the bootloader. Requires restart.
omk_hint_overrideTelephonyProperties: false fills only empty IMEI/MEID fields from the device.
omk_hint_imei: Private. Leave empty to let OMK fill it.
patch_intro: Write a spoofed security patch date to the active keystore backend.
patch_backend_hint: Patch date is applied to this backend
patch_fetch_desc: Get the latest date from the Pixel security bulletin.
hash_refresh_desc: Re-read the hash from the device and apply it now.
hash_paste_blocked: Clipboard unavailable, long-press the field to paste
